fpga_toolchain.note: No Xilinx/AMD Vitis, Vivado, or XRT toolchain is installed in this environment, and no physical Alveo U55C is attached or detectable. All FPGA-side results in this project are therefore Tier T4 (simulation / analytical cycle model) only. See NOTES/blockers.md and paper Section 6 'Scope and limitations of the hardware evaluation'.
